title: 第一卷第13章 特殊血脉破妄之瞳第一卷第14章 图穷顾家围杀
content_zh:
“阿傻……”
强忍着巨大不适感，顾寒咬破舌尖，手臂颤颤巍巍伸出，落在了阿傻肩头上。
“你……怎么了……”
“少爷。”
被顾寒一碰。
阿傻眼中两道幽光瞬间消失不见。
只是，她的眼神再次变得浑浑噩噩，一片茫然，似乎先前的灵动和活泼，也随着幽光一起消散而去。
“少爷……”
她脸上浮现一股浓浓的倦色，直接躺在了顾寒怀里。
“阿傻好累啊……”
糟了！
听到她对自己的称呼。
顾寒心里猛地一沉。
话未说完。
阿傻又是和先前一样，再次沉沉睡去。
“杀了我……求求你了……”
一旁。
汉子依旧在苦苦哀求，只是声音越来越弱。
顾寒怒火中烧。
“若不是你们，阿傻怎么可能又变成了这样！”

“想痛快的死？”
“不可能！”
森冷地看了他一眼，他抱起阿傻，瞬间远去。
“吼！”
片刻之后。
数声咆哮声响起！
却是附近的妖兽觉察到了血腥味，纷纷来到了这里。
他的下场。
不言而喻。
……
“你说什么！”
意识空间内。
黑影听了顾寒的讲述，激动万分，腾地一下站了起来，双手搓动不停。
content_en:
"Asham..."
Holding back the huge discomfort, Gu Han bit the tip of his tongue, stretched out his arm tremblingly, and landed on Ah Sha's shoulder.
"What's wrong with you..."
"Master."
Touched by Gu Han.
The two dim lights in Adu's eyes disappeared instantly.
However, her eyes once again became hazy and blank, as if the previous agility and liveliness had also dissipated along with the dim light.
"Master..."
A strong look of tiredness appeared on her face, and she lay directly in Gu Han's arms.
"Ah Sha, I'm so tired..."
Oops!
Hear what she calls herself.
Gu Han's heart suddenly sank.
The words are not finished yet.
Ah Sha fell asleep again just like before.
"Kill me...please..."
aside.
The man was still pleading, but his voice became weaker and weaker.
Gu Han was furious.
"If it weren't for you, how could Asha have become like this again!"
"Want to die happily?"
"Impossible!"
Giving him a cold look, he picked up Ah Sha and walked away in an instant.
"Roar!"
After a while.
Several roars sounded!
However, the nearby monsters noticed the smell of blood and came here one after another.
His fate.
it goes without saying.

within the space of consciousness.
